scope: UI migration inventory. Ported means the described UI behavior is present, not real-engine physics acceptance. Deferred phases ui and engine are still MVP obligations; later is agreed post-MVP work; decision requires scope clarification. Groups list exact IDs, never wildcard defaults.

groups.name: experiment-controls
groups.reason: Energy, scan, resolution, simulation and polarization controls update the project. D-39 production requests use the real WASM worker; complete numerical acceptance remains in AGENTS.md.

groups.name: sample-controls
groups.reason: Segmentation settings, element navigation, optical cache and magnetization controls exist. Imported tables persist in the browser library. Production uses native optical/profile preparation and the approved built-in Chantler fallback; full-project acceptance remains separate.

groups.name: fit-controls
groups.reason: Fit settings, parameter editing and value transfer feed the real worker Simplex/annealing path, weighted datasets and Q regularization. Complete original-project fit-quality acceptance remains open.

groups.name: dataset-list
groups.reason: Selection, fit inclusion, ordering and deletion use model actions; property editing is classified separately.

groups.name: layout
groups.reason: Modern tabs, section panels, menu structure and toolbar replace VCL containers (D-16, D-18).

groups.name: plot-basics
groups.reason: Hold, Clear and Scale exist in the plot panel. Other plot controls are classified separately.

groups.name: project-files
groups.reason: JSON open/save and legacy import, ASCII diagram/table export and browser file pickers replace VCL file dialogs (D-8, D-13).

groups.name: ascii-import
groups.reason: Column-role selectors, ignore roles, live preview and separator/decimal controls replace the legacy column-list buttons (D-16).

groups.name: layer-actions
groups.reason: Add/remove layers, compound/element mode and element navigation exist. Table interactions are tracked separately.

groups.name: undo-redo
groups.reason: Reducer history and keyboard/menu undo and redo replace the VCL actions.

groups.name: script-editor
groups.reason: Default/BeforeCalculation editors, snippets, execution controls and output are connected to the real worker with atomic project application and cancellation. The registered Lua surface is audited (I3); CalculateReflectivity/GetError are explicitly excluded by D-43/D-49 and report named errors. D-50 defines array integer conversion; final script acceptance remains A5.

groups.name: preferences-controls
groups.reason: Preferences preserve project settings. D-39 uses the real WASM engine, but stored options do not imply support for deferred physics or the excluded Fourier feature (D-44).

groups.name: about-license
groups.reason: Web About and GPL license dialogs replace the legacy notice/version presentation (D-16, D-31).

groups.name: dataset-properties
groups.reason: Selected dataset editor covers title/comment, energy/energy shift, angular resolution, scale/offset/qz shift/error weight, complex beam polarizations and read-only metadata. Real fit preparation consumes these settings; full numerical acceptance remains separate.

groups.name: angle-axis
groups.reason: Theta display converts simulated and measured qz coordinates with the legacy hc and current experiment energy; exports use the displayed coordinates. Energy scans and depth profiles retain their axes. Out-of-range values are reported.

groups.name: plot-tools
groups.reason: Plot Properties supports exact axis ranges, interval counts (linear/log interpolation), log toggles, background/border and eight pen colors, font size, line width and points. Apply validates ranges; Cancel leaves the plot unchanged. Navigation and exports are tracked separately.

groups.name: plot-area-selection
groups.reason: D-54: chart-local Select/Clear Area uses an ordered full-height x interval on linear/log axes; zero-width selections clear and project fit windows remain unchanged.

groups.name: plot-line-fit
groups.reason: D-54/D-55: second-series Lorentzian+Step fit via real ComputeService/WASM clean-room optimizer, consistent best-result overlay/error/parameter export, explicit invalid-input errors, Stop and stale-result cancellation. Project state is unchanged; original trajectory equivalence is not claimed.

groups.name: multichart-activation-decision
groups.reason: D-56 explicitly excludes the unused TMultiChart 1/2/4-chart container and its four activation handlers. Ordinary plots and the separate Summary overview remain supported.

groups.name: layer-table-interactions
groups.reason: Layer/slab editing, Fit, value slider, spectra, material settings and database actions are implemented. D-53 excludes the obsolete coupl. column; Lua layer coupling remains supported. Original 2.6 has no file key for the column, so no inferred import warning.

groups.name: value-slider
groups.reason: Fixed-baseline 0–4× slider for eligible layer/slab/scattering-factor, magnetic profile/spline and script values, with current-view recalculation during dragging, gesture undo and stale-target clearing.

groups.name: segmentation-actions
groups.reason: To layer list uses ComputeService capabilities and real production conversion with the D-41 double lookup. Previews apply atomically with undo, preserving element mode/profiles/targets; stale results cannot apply and Stop targets the original service. Single-row semantics and final original-project review remain open.

groups.name: element-tools
groups.reason: Material to Elements uses the worker, preserves retained material layers, previews overwritten element data and removed element-specific fit references, reports skipped formulas, and applies atomically with undo. Empty results cannot replace data. Stop and stale snapshot guards protect pending requests. Legacy mass lookup and parser quirks are retained; multilayer/Lua expansion remains engine work.

groups.name: magnetic-fit-controls
groups.reason: Four active legacy profile Fit checkboxes synchronize with the parameter list and undo; deletion preserves surviving target/coupling identities. Real fit parameter mapping and native profile preparation exist; endpoint/binding decisions and original-project fit acceptance remain open.

groups.name: magnetic-profile-editor
groups.reason: Gaussian and spline editing, legacy all/air/layer/bulk/none binding choices and earlier-profile coupling choices are present. Layer edits preserve binding identities; stored unusual references stay visible. Real-engine profile evaluation remains deferred.

groups.name: materials
groups.reason: Material Settings provides read-only structural/optical values, draft formula/density/gamma/phi and Fit flags, atomic OK/undo, Cancel and concurrent-edit preservation. The separate tensor view uses the real worker. Hidden Fill Dielectric Tensor remains a scope decision.

groups.name: summary
groups.reason: D-52: real-worker all-dataset Summary snapshot with measured/calculated charts, weighted errors, sizing/layout-only Update, scan-specific x scaling, qz y scaling and full clipboard exports. Inactive datasets included; unsupported TEY fails explicitly. Independent Stop/close preserves project state. Extra interpolation excluded; final user-example acceptance stays A5.

groups.name: summary-conversion-decision
groups.reason: D-52 explicitly excludes the extra Summary cross-dataset interpolation command for now; the regular Summary remains in scope.

groups.name: lua-execution
groups.reason: Both Tools script commands and the Script Window share real worker execution, output/errors and Stop. Menu execution selects the program and opens its output; closing cancels active work and resets window output/tab. Full legacy API/numerical acceptance remains separate (D-2, D-22).

groups.name: stop-deadline
groups.reason: Stop cancels standalone work immediately and gives fits a cooperative stop with a non-extendable 250 ms termination fallback. Controls cover scans, profiles, fits and chi-square; paused redraw prevents automatic restart. Real blocked-worker tests pass the 1 s threshold. Chromium headless tests verify progress, tab response below 200 ms, Stop below 1 s with blocked workers, and calculation recovery (app/e2e/responsiveness.spec.ts).

groups.name: worker-lifecycle
groups.reason: Worker error/messageerror and startup/send failures reject all pending requests without changing project state. Failed workers are detached and terminated, the next request creates a replacement, and disposal rejects further work. Chromium headless cancellation and recovery tests also pass (app/e2e/responsiveness.spec.ts). Fit/evaluation callbacks are also guarded by a session epoch; structural edits and project loading clear previews and discard the old worker independently of the mounted panel.

groups.name: evolution
groups.reason: Evolution fitting and its progress/settings section are later under D-11/D-25.

groups.name: maps
groups.reason: 2D maps and map controls are later under D-25.

groups.name: electric-field
groups.reason: Electric-field visualization and its wave/phase controls are later under D-26. The separate optical/magnetic depth-profile view uses the production WASM engine.

groups.name: scratch
groups.reason: Scratch utilities require the existing D-25 scope decision before implementation.

groups.name: non-mvp-physics
groups.reason: PHASE, TEY and transmission remain later under D-25 even where the preferences UI stores their values.

groups.name: opencl
groups.reason: Experimental hardware selection and OpenCL are later under D-25.

groups.name: hidden-tools-decision
groups.reason: Hidden experimental/test controls require a scope review; not silently treated as ported or dropped.

groups.name: precision-parallel
groups.reason: Precision choices and the parallel-computing switch are dropped; the web app uses double and a worker (F-3, AGENTS.md Dropped).

groups.name: webserver
groups.reason: Webserver is explicitly dropped by D-35.

groups.name: lm
groups.reason: Levenberg-Marquardt is dropped by D-11; imports fall back to Simplex under D-27.

groups.name: desktop-windows
groups.reason: Exit, splash, unused EnergyInput/empty frames and Stay on Top are explicitly dropped in AGENTS.md; the app is browser-local (D-19).

groups.name: unused-database-frame
groups.reason: The unused GetFromDatabaseFrame is dropped in AGENTS.md; its useful database action remains in the deferred layer-table menu.

groups.name: plot-navigation
groups.reason: Wheel zoom centers on the pointer with half/double extents in linear or log space. Zoom Out expands around the plot center; Scale restores data bounds. Cursor readout uses displayed axis coordinates.

groups.name: plot-export
groups.reason: Copy chart data as paired x/y columns (including held data), copy the rendered chart and legend as PNG, and Save Picture as legacy JPEG; clipboard denial is reported without changing the project.

groups.name: cell-fit-menu
groups.reason: Fit (On/Off) on supported compound and element cells, including element scattering factors. Mouse and keyboard menu, fit highlighting, parameter-list synchronization and undo are implemented; new entries use the existing Fit-tab parameter defaults.

groups.name: magnetic-profile-spline
groups.reason: Build spline creates the legacy nine samples and enables spline mode; five interior y values are editable with preserved boundaries, undo and JSON save. Native/WASM profile interpolation is integrated for defined coordinates; the first-knot decision and full acceptance remain open.

groups.name: compound-spectrum-menu
groups.reason: Compound optical/magnetic spectrum actions use ComputeService and the real worker for per-energy table refresh, tensor handling and BeforeCalculation. Full spectrum/original-project acceptance remains open.

groups.name: element-scattering-factors
groups.reason: Show Scattering Factors follows element selection through ComputeService. Production resolves imported/Chantler tables and per-energy BeforeCalculation, reports missing data and supports plot exports. Full original-project spectrum acceptance remains open.

groups.name: element-density-profiles
groups.reason: Sample/toolbar actions show all element density profiles through the real worker with the production double lookup, shared depth axis, slab boundaries, edits, undo and exports. Final original-project/manual review remains open.

groups.name: materials-tensor-display
groups.reason: Read-only real/imaginary 3x3 matrices use native tensor preparation through ComputeService, with Stop and no project mutation. This UI record does not close full tensor/physics acceptance.

groups.name: database-update-actions
groups.reason: Database actions update the active stack through native interpolation/tensor preparation and approved Chantler fallback. Reports retain skips/ranges/missing magnetic data; updates are atomic with undo and stale-result guards. Full .F element assignment remains pending its decision.

groups.name: dielectric-tensor-spectra
groups.reason: Three legacy component groups use real per-energy table refresh and BeforeCalculation: diagonal 1-Re/Im and off-diagonal Re/Im. Table grids and missing-data errors are retained; full original-project acceptance remains open.

groups.name: element-optical-spectrum-menu
groups.reason: The element context action selects the slab and energy grid; the real worker prepares density-weighted element optics with per-energy refresh/Lua. Missing-table/slab errors and project preservation remain explicit. Full original-project acceptance remains open.

groups.name: segmentation-illustration
groups.reason: The display checkbox switches optical/magnetic profiles between smooth curves and steps with boundary strokes. Production profiles use native adaptive preparation and the D-41 full-double lookup. Exports use displayed points; toggling does not edit project data. Final numerical review remains open.

groups.name: fourier-excluded
groups.reason: Fourier transformation and fitting are excluded by D-44. The activation control and execution paths are removed; old saved settings remain readable and explicitly reported with an undoable removal action.
